regime_context: Hong Kong detector shows Tech Hardware & Semis as the eligible leader, but with narrow breadth (0.33). The absolute trend gate has a validated risk-control edge in this market. No theme is crowded, and rotation is narrowing. Macro backdrop is highly surprise-driven (unscheduled share 0.97).
emerging_watch: Watch if Diversified Miners (currently the momentum leader but ineligible) passes the absolute trend gate and its score overtakes Tech Hardware & Semis as the top eligible theme, which would signal a potential rotation into resources. The condition is: miners become eligible and rank #1 in the next detector update.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is the highest-ranked eligible theme, passing the absolute trend gate with a durable trend (durability 0.68, hurst=trend). The gate historically reduces drawdowns in Hong Kong, and the lack of crowding removes an immediate size-down flag. However, the very low constituent breadth (0.33) signals fragility, so conviction is kept low.
evidence: Rank 2 overall, rank 1 among eligible themes; eligible = true
Absolute trend gate validation: gate_helps = true
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth means the trend is driven by a minority of names; if those falter, the theme can reverse quickly. High macro unscheduled share (0.97) raises the risk of sudden sentiment shifts against tech.

falsifier.text: In the next detector snapshot (within ~2-3 weeks), Tech Hardware & Semis is no longer eligible or its durability bar drops below 0.55.

theses.subject: Industrials & Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Industrials & Infrastructure shows the strongest trend structure among eligible themes: high durability (0.72), full constituent breadth (0.889), and hurst=trend. While not the momentum leader, its robust, diversified trend aligns well with the absolute trend gate's risk-control property, potentially offering a smoother ride than the headline theme.
evidence: Absolute trend gate validated for risk management in HK (gate_helps: true)
theses.dissent: As a lower-momentum theme, it may underperform if capital concentrates further in tech hardware. Infrastructure sentiment can be sensitive to China policy shifts or global macro surprises.

falsifier.text: If the Industrials & Infrastructure theme becomes ineligible (fails the trend gate) in the next two detector snapshots or the Hang Seng Industrials sub-index declines by more than 4% within 20 trading days.
